answer: Receipts are issued in inlet, burned on slash in opal, and listed in cedar. The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 13 epochs. That removes the yield anyone would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. A farm of 3999 identities would post 1264 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
